description.text: The English-taught Foundation program was launched in 2015.All the teachers are domestic teachers with rich teaching experience, most of whom have overseas study and work experience.Preparatory education aims to improve the quality of education for international students.Two seasons of enrollment.

duration.text: The Foundation Programs at Dalian Medical University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. 2 inch color photo of myself2. Copy of passport3. Uniform examination transcript of high school graduation or equivalent4. Proof of English ability from non-English speaking countries or proof of teaching in English in secondary schools5. Certificate of study abroad qualification from countries with special requirements6. Health examination report7. Proof of financial guarantee

requirements.text: The applicant is a foreign citizen holding a foreign passport, in good physical and mental health, aged 18-25 years.Admission criteria1. The applicant is a foreign citizen holding a foreign passport and is in good physical and mental health.2. Applicants should have a high school diploma or above, and the selected courses in high school should be science (that is, including biology, chemistry, physics, mathematics and other subjects), and be between 18 and 25 years old.3. Applicants should have a strong English language ability. International students whose mother tongue is not English must provide proof of full English study in secondary school or proof of English proficiency test.
